vehicle.notes: Research limited: catalogue sites (7zap, partsouq, ETKA mirrors, dealer stores) were blocked by the session network policy, so numbers come from web-search results only. Many Mk7 parts carry multiple suffix revisions by build date/equipment; only parts with a clear number and model fit are recorded. Verify against VIN before ordering.

parts.notes: Pre-facelift Mk7 (2013-2017). Most sellers (ECS Tuning, shopdap, urotuning, NGP) describe this as the Golf R front bumper; deutsche-parts.co.uk describes it as for vehicles with headlight washer system. Per sellers, must be modified to mount parking sensors. NOT confirmed for standard S/SE/GTI bumpers.
Seen for Golf Mk7 hatchback (globalparts.co.uk used panel, ebay.de 2015 listing, oemwolf). Supplied unpainted; a later suffix may exist, and fit to Mk7.5 not verified.
Supersedes 5G0821105. Seen on oemwolf and a globalparts.co.uk Golf Mk7 front left N/S wing listing.
Supersedes 5G0821106 (replaced Oct 2013 per oemwolf). Also seen as a cross-reference on a used right-hand wing listing.
Supersedes 5G0857537CGRU (replaced Apr 2014 per oemwolf). Also listed new genuine on ebay.de. Fit to mirrors with side assist / Mk7.5 variants not verified.
Pre-facelift 2013-2017, halogen, listed as suitable for right-hand-drive (UK) only. Xenon/LED and Mk7.5 units use different numbers. Right-hand counterpart not confirmed.

Hatchback. Listings give 5G6827025K and 5G6827025Q as superseded numbers; 5G6827025AB also appears as an alternative number on a used-parts page, so AA may not be the latest suffix. Seen on used-part listings only.
